signatureGeometry.panelCurve: Card 22px corners; inner panel 22px 22px 26px 26px so the light panel's rounded bottom curves into the forest footer. Photo inset 10px with 16px 16px 12px 12px corners.
signatureGeometry.tabbarPath: M0 30Q0 4 26 4C84 4 126 50 195 50S306 4 364 4Q390 4 390 30V124H0Z (viewBox 0 0 390 124, preserveAspectRatio none, 104px tall, max 560px wide)
signatureGeometry.tabGrid: 1fr 1fr 96px 1fr 1fr; the 96px gap sits under the 66px raised save button.
signatureGeometry.historyBars: max 24 points, 96px tall, 6px gap, 6 to 34px wide, height 32% to 100% (70% when flat), corners 8px 8px 4px 4px.

behaviour.removeNeverDeletes: Remove and Mark as bought move an item to Bought & removed with a 5s Undo toast. Only 'Delete forever' in the Bought & removed list deletes, after a second tap within 3s ('Tap again to delete').
behaviour.putBack: 'Put back' (removed) or 'Back to wishlist' (bought) returns an item to the rack.
behaviour.placeholder: No photo shows the hanger symbol with 'No photo yet'; never a fabricated photo.

components.css: .ds-card { width: 180px; border-radius: var(--r-lg, 22px); overflow: hidden; background: var(--forest, #12493b); box-shadow: var(--lift, 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(18, 73, 59, .45)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: var(--font, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-panel { background: var(--panel, #dcebe3); border-radius: var(--r-lg, 22px) var(--r-lg, 22px) 26px 26px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-pic { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 15%, var(--panel-hi, #f4faf7) 0, var(--panel, #dcebe3) 70%); } .ds-flag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 14px; background: var(--go-bg, #fff); color: var(--drop, #2a7d45); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 9px 4px 7px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; box-shadow: var(--lift-sm, 0 6px 16px -10px rgba(18, 73, 59, .5)); } .ds-body { display: grid; gap: 1px; padding: 12px 12px 16px; } .ds-store { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-2, #56685f); } .ds-name { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.28; color: var(--title, #12493b); } .ds-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 10px 13px 13px; color: var(--on-forest, #fff); } .ds-price { font-weight: 600; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.15; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-price s { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--on-forest-3, #a9cbbd); } .ds-go { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--go-bg, #fff); color: var(--go-ink, #12493b); display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--on-forest, #fff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-banner { position: relative; margin-top: 40px; min-height: 156px; border-radius: var(--r-lg, 22px); background: var(--forest, #12493b); color: var(--on-forest, #fff); box-shadow: var(--lift, 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(18, 73, 59, .45)); font-family: var(--font, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-slide { padding: 22px 166px 40px 34px; } .ds-slide h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-slide p { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--on-forest-2, #cfe3d9); } .ds-slide b { color: var(--on-forest, #fff); font-weight: 600; } .ds-art { position: absolute; right: 16px; bottom: 14px; width: 120px; height: 168px; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--panel, #dcebe3); box-shadow: 0 18px 30px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45); } .ds-tag { position: absolute; right: 24px; top: -10px; z-index: 1; background: var(--go-bg, #fff); color: var(--drop, #2a7d45); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: var(--lift-sm, 0 6px 16px -10px rgba(18, 73, 59, .5)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-bar { position: relative; width: 390px; max-width: 100%; height: 104px; } .ds-bar-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 104px; filter: drop-shadow(0 -8px 18px var(--bar-shadow, rgba(18, 73, 59, .14))); } .ds-bar-bg path { fill: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-fab { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 4px; margin-left: -33px; width: 66px; height: 66px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; background: var(--surface, #fff); display: grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: var(--lift, 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(18, 73, 59, .45)); z-index: 1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab span { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--forest, #12493b); color: var(--on-forest, #fff); display: grid; place-items: center; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-fab:active span { transform: scale(.92); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--title, #12493b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tabs { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 96px 1fr 1fr; justify-items: center; } .ds-tab { position: relative; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #56685f); display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--title, #12493b); } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 3px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--title, #12493b); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Design C, pinned by the owner from a reference screenshot of a plant-shop app and approved as a preview. A mint-washed page holds soft white controls and pale green photo panels; deep forest green carries everything that matters about money and action: the price-drop banner, every card's price footer, the primary buttons and the raised save button. The signature move is the curve: each product card's light photo panel ends in a rounded bottom (26px) that sits inside a forest card, so the green reads as a footer the panel curves into, and the one white bottom bar dips in the middle to cradle the save button.

The app is dense but soft: a two-column grid on the phone, large radii (12 to 28px) everywhere, no hairlines between things, depth from green-tinted ambient shadows rather than borders. Poppins at 400 to 700 does all the talking, with tabular figures for every price. Day (mint) is the default look; Night swaps the same roles to dark greens and turns the shadows black.

It replaces the earlier navy knitted world entirely; nothing from that world (stitch textures, ribbed edges, mustard buttons, Bricolage Grotesque or Figtree) carries over.
keyCharacteristics: Forest green (#12493b) is the money-and-action colour: banner, card footers, primary actions, selected states.
Light panels curve into forest footers; the curve is the card.
One curved white bottom bar with a raised forest save button in its dip.
Sage chips, white circle buttons, white discs on green.
Price history as rounded bars: forest fell, rose rose, sage no change.
Removing never deletes; Bought & removed holds everything until "Delete forever".
Day default, Night as dark green; Poppins only.

rules.name: The Money Is Green Rule
rules.body: Forest is where price and action live: footers, banner, primary buttons, the save button, selected states. Supporting controls are sage or white, never a second strong colour.

rules.name: The White Disc Rule
rules.body: Anything small and round sitting on green (the store arrow, drop flags, the bought pill, the banner tag) is a white disc or pill with forest or status-coloured ink, in both themes.

rules.name: The Three-Bar Rule
rules.body: Price history speaks in exactly three colours: forest for a fall, rose for a rise, sage for no change, with a legend only for directions that occur.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Every price, tally, flag amount and axis date uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Poppins only; hierarchy comes from weight (400 to 700) and size, never a second face.

rules.name: The No-Line Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone and soft shadow, not borders. The only strokes are focus rings, the warning field, the drop-target dash and the crop frame.

dos: Do put prices, primary actions and selected states on forest (#12493b), and keep supporting controls sage or white.
Do build every product card as a light panel with a 26px rounded bottom curving into a forest price footer, with a white go disc to the store.
Do keep one curved white bottom bar with the raised forest save button in its dip.
Do use the three history colours exactly: forest fell, rose rose, sage no change.
Do send removed and bought items to Bought & removed with Undo; reserve deletion for "Delete forever" with its tap-again confirmation.
Do use the `--lift` and `--lift-sm` shadows for depth and let Night swap them to black.
Do set every price and amount in tabular figures.
Do show the hanger placeholder ("No photo yet") when there is no photo.
donts: Don't separate surfaces with borders or hairlines; use tone and soft shadow.
Don't introduce a second strong accent; rose is for rising-price bars only and sale red is for discounts and errors.
Don't add a second typeface or weights outside 400 to 700.
Don't use square corners; buttons, chips and fields start at 12px (only small marks such as legend keys, the progress bar and the crop box go tighter).
Don't fabricate product photos; placeholders show the hanger.
Don't bring back anything from the old navy knitted world (stitch charts, ribbed edges, mustard, Bricolage Grotesque, Figtree).
